title: Hermit language
description: Extinct West Manus language of Papua New Guinea
extract: The Hermit language is a critically endangered West Manus language formerly spoken on Hermit, Luf and Maron Islands in western Manus Province, Papua New Guinea. It has been replaced by Seimat.
